sideEffects.note: Every probe in this pass was a GET or a socket queue/cancel. No learner write was committed; the one socket join_queue was refused by the server's own balance guard, so no currency moved.

serverSideEnforcement.method: direct GET of premium detail and transcript endpoints as the FREE identity, bypassing the UI entirely

privacy.evidence: GET /quizzes/{24,26,27,28}/transcript returns 403 'Hay xac nhan xem transcript truoc khi tai noi dung' for an entitled PRO identity that has not revealed. Quizzes 23 and 9 return 200 only because that identity already revealed them. No unrevealed payload carried transcript prose.

idor.reason: The QA identities own no cross-checkable submission objects (GET /users/learning-history returned no sourceIds for student2), and manufacturing one would create learner state this audit-only pass is not allowed to commit. Socket-layer authorisation was verified instead: an unauthenticated /arena connection is rejected with 'Authentication token required for Arena'.

retractedEarlierFinding.claim: transcriptSegments[].startMs populated for 0 of 120 segments, so per-question seeking is impossible
retractedEarlierFinding.explanation: The delivered payload carries startMs/endMs on each transcript ITEM, not on a nested segments array. The earlier checker looked only at the nested shape and therefore read zero. Re-measured against the real shape, 23 and 25 expose 20 of 20 offsets over the live API and all 4 published artifacts validate.

endpointSweep.falsePositivesRetracted: An earlier sweep reported 12 404s across /toeic/exam-sets, /market/items and two arena status paths. All four were paths this audit invented; the real routes are /toeic/exams, /market/products and the /arena socket namespace, and each returns 200 or its proper socket event. /courses/my-enrollments returned 400 for the same reason: the real route is /courses/:courseId/my-enrollments.

unverified.MATCH_COMPLETION: blocked - both QA identities hold totalBanh=0 and granting currency would mutate canonical user state
